question: From the first year each actor appeared in a film to the last, how many actors in the database never had a gap longer than three consecutive years without at least one new movie appearance, meaning there is no four-year span anywhere in their active career without at least a single film credit?
sql:
-- Check single year actor in the full pipeline
WITH actor_years AS (
    SELECT mc.PID, TRY_CAST(m.year AS INTEGER) as yr
    FROM M_Cast mc
    JOIN Movie m ON mc.MID = m.MID
    WHERE TRY_CAST(m.year AS INTEGER) IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY mc.PID, TRY_CAST(m.year AS INTEGER)
),
actor_range AS (
    SELECT PID, MIN(yr) as first_yr, MAX(yr) as last_yr
    FROM actor_years
    GROUP BY PID
),
all_years AS (
    SELECT ar.PID, ar.first_yr, ar.last_yr,
           ar.first_yr + g.n as career_year
    FROM actor_range ar
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT UNNEST(range(0, ar.last_yr - ar.first_yr + 1)) as n) g
),
actor_career AS (
    SELECT ay.PID, ay.career_year,
           CASE WHEN ay.PID IN (SELECT PID FROM actor_years WHERE yr = ay.career_year) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as had_movie
    FROM all_years ay
)
SELECT PID, career_year, had_movie
FROM actor_career
WHERE PID = ' nm0000002'

{"preview_rows": 20, "sql": "-- Show some actors with max_gap >= 4
WITH actor_years AS (
    SELECT mc.PID, TRY_CAST(m.year AS INTEGER) as yr
    FROM M_Cast mc
    JOIN Movie m ON mc.MID = m.MID
    WHERE TRY_CAST(m.year AS INTEGER) IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY mc.PID, TRY_CAST(m.year AS INTEGER)
),
actor_range AS (
    SELECT PID, MIN(yr) as first_yr, MAX(yr) as last_yr
    FROM actor_years
    GROUP BY PID
),
all_years AS (
    SELECT ar.PID, ar.first_yr, ar.last_yr,
           ar.first_yr + g.n as career_year
    FROM actor_range ar
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT UNNEST(range(0, ar.last_yr - ar.first_yr + 1)) as n) g
),
actor_career AS (
    SELECT ay.PID, ay.career_year,
           CASE WHEN ay.PID IN (SELECT PID FROM actor_years WHERE yr = ay.career_year) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as had_movie
    FROM all_years ay
),
gaps AS (
    SELECT PID, career_year, had_movie,
           SUM(had_movie) OVER (PARTITION BY PID ORDER BY career_year) as grp
    FROM actor_career
),
gap_lengths AS (
    SELECT PID, grp, COUNT(*) as gap_len
    FROM gaps
    WHERE had_movie = 0
    GROUP BY PID, grp
),
max_gaps AS (
    SELECT PID, MAX(gap_len) as max_gap
    FROM gap_lengths
    GROUP BY PID
)
SELECT mg.PID, ar.first_yr, ar.last_yr, mg.max_gap
FROM max_gaps mg
JOIN actor_range ar ON mg.PID = ar.PID
WHERE mg.max_gap >= 4
ORDER BY mg.max_gap DESC
LIMIT 10"}
